input.goal: Single self-contained index.html: interactive full-viewport canvas orbital particle simulation with glassmorphism HUD, click bursts, zero external dependencies.
input.request:
Create a single self-contained file index.html implementing an interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space (#060913):
1. Responsive full-window <canvas> using requestAnimationFrame and devicePixelRatio scaling.
2. Central glowing star using createRadialGradient and a subtle corona pulse.
3. At least 5 orbiting planets with distinct orbital radii, speeds, colors, at least 3 moons/satellites, and fading orbital trails.
4. Twinkling background starfield with at least 150 stars.
5. Interactive glassmorphism HUD overlay with:
   - Play/Pause toggle button
   - Trails ON/OFF toggle button
   - Reset button
   - Speed range slider (<input type="range" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">) with live multiplier readout
   - Live FPS, simulation time (s), and active burst particle count
6. Clicking anywhere on the canvas spawns a radial burst of glowing particles with velocity damping and fade-out.
Keep everything self-contained in index.html with zero external dependencies and valid JavaScript syntax.

Usa Tandem.
constraints: Only file: index.html, no external URLs/fonts/scripts/images; all CSS in <style>, all JS in one inline <script>.
html, body: margin 0, overflow hidden, background #060913. <canvas id="sim"> position fixed, inset 0, width 100vw, height 100vh, display block.

Resize: canvas.width = innerWidth*dpr, canvas.height = innerHeight*dpr with dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1, 2); ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0); listen to 'resize'. Star centered at (innerWidth/2, innerHeight/2). Orbit radii scaled by s = Math.min(innerWidth, innerHeight)/900 (min 0.35).
Each frame: fill whole canvas with #060913 (opaque) then draw starfield, orbits, trails, star, planets, moons, bursts. Use requestAnimationFrame; dt = min((now-last)/1000, 0.05).

Starfield: exactly 220 stars, random positions in normalized 0..1 coords (re-mapped on resize), radius 0.3–1.5px, base alpha 0.3–0.9, twinkle alpha = base*(0.55+0.45*sin(t*speed+phase)) with speed 0.5–3 rad/s; color #ffffff, ~15% tinted #aac8ff. Twinkle uses real time so it animates even when paused.

Central star: core radius 28px*s(min 18px). Glow via ctx.createRadialGradient from center radius 0 to radius 140*s: stops 0 '#fff8e1', 0.15 '#ffd36b', 0.4 'rgba(255,150,40,0.35)', 1 'rgba(255,120,20,0)'. Corona pulse: glow radius multiplied by 1+0.06*sin(realTime*2.2). Draw with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter' for glow.

Planets (exactly 6), radius in px before scale s, angular speed rad/sim-second, color, size px: Mercury-like 'Ember' r=80 w=1.6 #c9a27e size 4; 'Azure' r=130 w=1.1 #4fa3ff size 7; 'Verdant' r=190 w=0.8 #4cd98a size 8; 'Crimson' r=255 w=0.6 #ff5a4e size 6; 'Gold' r=330 w=0.42 #f2c14e size 13; 'Violet' r=400 w=0.3 #b48cff size 10. Random initial angle seeded deterministic: angle0 = index*1.1.

Planets drawn with a radial gradient (light highlight offset -0.35*size) and a soft glow (shadowBlur 12, shadowColor = planet color). Faint orbit ellipse path: circle stroke rgba(255,255,255,0.06) lineWidth 1.

Moons (exactly 4): Azure has 1 moon (dist 14px, w 4.0, size 2, #d8e2ff); Verdant has 1 moon (dist 16, w 3.2, size 2.2, #e6e6e6); Gold has 2 moons (dist 22 w 2.5 size 2.5 #ffe9b0, dist 30 w -1.7 size 2 #cfd8ff). Moon distances not scaled.

Trails: each planet keeps a history array of last 90 positions (push each frame while playing). Draw trail as segments with alpha fading linearly from 0 (oldest) to 0.55 (newest) in planet color, lineWidth 2. Moons keep 30 positions, max alpha 0.4, lineWidth 1. When trails OFF: do not draw and clear histories.

HUD: <div id="hud"> fixed top 16px left 16px, width 260px, padding 14px 16px, border-radius 14px, background rgba(20,28,50,0.45), backdrop-filter blur(12px) (plus -webkit-), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12), box-shadow 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), color #e6ecff, font 13px system-ui, sans-serif, z-index 10. Title 'Orbital Simulation' 15px weight 600.

HUD buttons in one row with gap 8px: <button id="btnPlay"> text 'Pause' when running / 'Play' when paused; <button id="btnTrails"> text 'Trails: ON' / 'Trails: OFF'; <button id="btnReset"> text 'Reset'. Button style: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18), color #e6ecff, border-radius 8px, padding 6px 10px, cursor pointer; hover background rgba(255,255,255,0.18).

Speed slider exactly: <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">, width 100%, with label 'Speed' and readout <span id="speedVal"> showing e.g. '1.0×' (value.toFixed(1)+'×'), updated on 'input' event.

Stats lines: <span id="fps"> (integer, updated every 0.5 s from frame counts), <span id="simTime"> simulation seconds with toFixed(1) + ' s', <span id="particleCount"> integer count of live burst particles. Labels 'FPS', 'Sim time', 'Particles'.
Simulation: simTime += dt*speed only when playing; planet angle = angle0 + w*simTime. Paused: planets, moons, bursts frozen (bursts not updated), starfield twinkle and corona continue.
Reset: simTime=0, clear all burst particles, clear trail histories, speed slider back to 1.0 and readout '1.0×', playing=true, trails=true (button texts updated).

Burst: on canvas 'pointerdown' (clicks on HUD do not reach canvas) spawn 80 particles at click CSS coords; angle evenly spaced + random jitter ±0.05 rad, speed random 60–260 px/s, life 1.2–2.0 s, size 1.5–3.5 px, hue random 15–55 or 180–220 (hsl(h,100%,65%)). Update per frame (when playing): v *= Math.pow(0.12, dt) (damping), pos += v*dt*speed, life -= dt*speed; alpha = life/maxLife; remove when life<=0. Draw with 'lighter' composite, radial gradient glow radius size*3. Cap total particles at 2000 (drop oldest).

Expose window.app = { get playing, get trails, get simTime, get speed, particles (array, live reference via getter), planets (array of 6 objects with name, radius, angle, x, y), moons (array of 4), stars (array of 220), togglePlay(), toggleTrails(), reset(), spawnBurst(x,y) }. Use getters so values are live.
